_说明_中文: 全局配置。修改后完整重启生效；只填写JSON配置值，以下_说明和_description字段仅供阅读。阶级独立属性、装备、AI、弹药与药水见roamer/tier1/tier2/tier3.json。
_description_en: Global configuration. Fully restart after editing. _说明 and _description fields are documentation only. Independent rank settings are in roamer/tier1/tier2/tier3.json.
_说明_vanilla_mode_中文: 原版模式，默认关闭；所有人类（含雇佣士兵）基础生命20、基础近战1并取消本模组近战/跳跃/三叉戟刺击倍率。武器、附魔、状态效果及外部生命修饰保留；不改变远程伤害、护甲、AI或装备。完整重启生效，已有实体按生命比例切换；关闭恢复保存的阶级生命。
_description_vanilla_mode_en: Default-off vanilla mode: all Humans, including hired soldiers, use 20 base health and 1 base melee damage without this mod's melee/jump/trident-stab multipliers. Keep weapons, enchantments, effects and external health modifiers. Ranged damage, armor, AI and equipment are unchanged. Restart; preserve health percentage and restore stored tier health when disabled.

tiers._说明_中文: 各阶人类的属性、新式移动速度、伤害倍率、武器散布、近战冷却和自然生成倍率。roamer/tier1/tier2/tier3 分别对应流浪者/一阶/二阶/三阶。
tiers._description_en: Per-tier attributes, new movement-speed settings, damage multipliers, weapon spread, melee cooldown and natural-spawn multiplier. roamer/tier1/tier2/tier3 correspond to Roamer/Tier 1/Tier 2/Tier 3.
tiers._说明_伤害层级_中文: 这里配置的是整个阶级，不是某个独立 NPC。各阶伤害倍率与 global.json 的对应全局倍率相乘，不互相覆盖；1 表示不额外调整，0 表示该类攻击不造成伤害。例如全局近战 1.7、本阶近战 0.5，合并倍率为 0.85。枪械伤害单独在 对应阶级文件或global.json 设置，不使用这里的近战/弓/三叉戟输出倍率。
tiers._description_damage_layers_en: These settings apply to an entire tier, not an individual NPC. Tier damage multipliers multiply the corresponding global values in global.json; neither overrides the other. 1 makes no additional change and 0 disables that attack's damage. For example, global melee 1.7 times tier melee 0.5 gives 0.85. Firearm damage is configured separately in rank files or global.json and does not use these melee/bow/trident outgoing multipliers.

roamer._说明_中文: 流浪者专用配置：按属性→移动→战斗→生成与装备→弹药与药水→枪械→雇佣阅读。本文件只影响本阶；总开关在global.json。修改后完整重启，出生装备/补给不补发给已有实体。
roamer._description_en: roamer settings: attributes, movement, combat, spawning/equipment, ammunition/potions, firearms, hiring. Applies only to this rank; master switches are in global.json. Restart to apply; spawn equipment/supplies are not reissued to existing entities.

attributes._说明_中文: 生命值范围以生命值点数计（2 点=1 颗心）；其余为实体基础属性。attack_damage 是基础近战攻击属性，不是伤害倍率或固定最终伤害，武器和状态效果仍可修改它；不参与弓、弩、投掷三叉戟和枪械伤害计算。实际近战伤害另乘全局和本阶近战倍率。
attributes._description_en: Health bounds use health points (2 points = 1 heart); the other values are base entity attributes. attack_damage is the base melee attack attribute, not a multiplier or fixed final damage; weapons and effects may still modify it. It is not used for bow, crossbow, thrown-trident or firearm damage. Actual melee damage also uses the global and tier melee multipliers.
attributes._说明_health_min_中文: 随机初始生命下限，范围1–1024点；2点=1颗心。
attributes._description_health_min_en: Minimum initial health, 1–1024 points; 2 points = 1 heart.
attributes._说明_health_max_中文: 随机初始生命上限，范围1–1024点；上下限倒置时自动交换。
attributes._description_health_max_en: Maximum initial health, 1–1024 points; reversed bounds are swapped.
attributes._说明_attack_damage_中文: 基础近战攻击属性，0–2048；装备、附魔和伤害倍率仍会继续计算。
attributes._description_attack_damage_en: Base melee attack attribute, 0–2048; equipment, enchantments and multipliers still apply.
attributes._说明_armor_中文: 基础护甲值，0–30；装备护甲另外计算。
attributes._description_armor_en: Base armor, 0–30; equipped armor adds separately.
attributes._说明_knockback_resistance_中文: 基础击退抗性，0–1；1表示完全抵抗常规击退。
attributes._description_knockback_resistance_en: Base knockback resistance, 0–1; 1 fully resists normal knockback.
attributes._说明_follow_range_中文: 目标探测属性，8–128格；不是雇佣跟随的启停距离。
attributes._description_follow_range_en: Target detection attribute, 8–128 blocks; not the hired-follow start/stop distance.

movement._说明_中文: 新速度公式的基础移动速度（默认 0.105，即普通玩家基础移速的 1.05 倍；可设 0.01–0.2）。疾跑与迅捷等状态效果沿用原版属性修正。
movement._description_en: Base movement attribute for the new speed formula (default 0.105, or 1.05x the normal player's base movement speed; range 0.01–0.2). Sprint and effects such as Speed use vanilla attribute modifiers.
movement._说明_base_speed_中文: 基础移速属性，0.01–0.2；默认0.105，保留原版疾跑及状态修正。
movement._description_base_speed_en: Base movement attribute, 0.01–0.2; default 0.105, with vanilla sprint/effect modifiers.
movement._说明_follow_speed_multiplier_中文: 闲置雇佣跟随导航倍率，0.1–3，默认1.35。
movement._说明_follow_catch_up_multiplier_中文: 距离主人超过12格的追赶倍率，0.1–3，默认1.6；不会低于普通跟随倍率。
movement._description_follow_catch_up_multiplier_: Catch-up multiplier beyond 12 blocks, 0.1–3; default 1.6, never below normal follow.
movement._说明_跟随_中文: 雇佣士兵无目标跟随的导航倍率：普通1.35，超过12格追赶1.6；超过6格疾跑，2.5格内停止，4格外重新启动。倍率0.1至3，仅影响跟随，不改变战斗/撤退/驻守。
movement._description_follow_en: Idle hired-follow navigation speed: 1.35 normally, 1.6 beyond 12 blocks; sprint beyond 6, stop within 2.5, restart beyond 4. Multipliers range 0.1-3; combat, retreat and guard are unchanged.

damage_multipliers._说明_中文: 输出倍率与 global.json 的对应全局倍率叠乘，默认 1 不额外调整。melee_damage_multiplier 用于近战（含三叉戟近刺）；bow_damage_multiplier 用于弓和弩的箭矢；trident_damage_multiplier 仅用于投掷三叉戟。incoming_damage_multiplier 属于受伤者：控制本阶人类受到的伤害（含枪伤和环境伤害），不是攻击输出倍率。枪械输出倍率另见 对应阶级文件或global.json。
damage_multipliers._description_en: Outgoing multipliers multiply the matching global values in global.json; the default 1 makes no additional change. melee_damage_multiplier covers melee, including trident stabs; bow_damage_multiplier covers arrows from bows and crossbows; trident_damage_multiplier covers thrown tridents only. incoming_damage_multiplier belongs to the defender and scales damage received by this tier, including firearms and environmental damage; it is not an outgoing multiplier. Firearm output is configured in rank files or global.json.
damage_multipliers._说明_melee_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶近战输出倍率，0–10；乘全局近战倍率。
damage_multipliers._description_melee_damage_multiplier_en: Rank melee output multiplier, 0–10; multiplies global melee scaling.
damage_multipliers._说明_bow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弓/弩输出倍率，0–10；乘全局弓弩倍率。
damage_multipliers._description_bow_damage_multiplier_en: Rank bow/crossbow output multiplier, 0–10; multiplies global projectile scaling.
damage_multipliers._说明_trident_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶投掷三叉戟输出倍率，0–10；不用于近刺。
damage_multipliers._description_trident_damage_multiplier_e: Rank thrown-trident output multiplier, 0–10; excludes melee stabs.
damage_multipliers._说明_incoming_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶受到伤害的倍率，0–10；0可免除此层伤害，包括环境和枪伤。
damage_multipliers._description_incoming_damage_multiplier_: Incoming damage multiplier for this rank, 0–10; 0 suppresses this layer, including environment/firearms.

weapon_spread_degrees._说明_中文: 该阶每一种枪械和弹射武器的独立瞄准散布角度；数值越小越精准。
weapon_spread_degrees._description_en: Independent aiming spread angles for every firearm and projectile weapon used by this tier; lower values are more accurate.

firearms._说明_中文: 枪械分类散布。sniper=狙击枪，rifle=步枪，mg=机枪，pistol=手枪，smg=冲锋枪，shotgun=霰弹枪，other=其他/无法识别类型。
firearms._description_en: Firearm spread by category: sniper, rifle, mg (machine gun), pistol, smg, shotgun, and other (unrecognized types).

projectiles._说明_中文: 弹射武器散布。bow=弓，crossbow=弩，trident=三叉戟；三类可分别设置。
projectiles._description_en: Projectile spread: bow, crossbow and trident are configured independently.

combat._说明_中文: 近战攻击冷却随机范围，单位为游戏 tick（20 tick=1 秒）。
combat._description_en: Random melee attack cooldown range in game ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_min_中文: 近战随机冷却下限，1–200 tick；20 tick=1秒。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_min_en: Minimum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second.
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_max_中文: 近战随机冷却上限，1–200 tick；上下限倒置时自动交换。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_max_en: Maximum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; reversed bounds are swapped.

spawning._说明_中文: spawn_multiplier 是本阶普通自然生成/区块初始自然生成的准入倍率，不是直接概率；允许 0–100 的整数或小数。相对于本项设为 1 时，0.5 保留 50%、0.1 保留 10%、0.01 保留 1% 的基础准入机会；可直接填写 0.005 等更小的数值，不加引号或百分号。0 禁止本阶普通自然生成。它与 global.json 的 admission_chance 相乘，仍受天数、地形、密度等条件限制；四阶使用相同准入规则，没有流浪者额外随机判定。自然大型战斗由 battle_admission_chance 单独控制，不乘此倍率；援军信号弹和敌对信标不受此项影响。
spawning._description_en: spawn_multiplier scales admission for this tier's ordinary and chunk-generation natural spawns; it is not a direct probability. Integers and decimals from 0 to 100 are accepted. Compared with setting this value to 1, 0.5 retains 50%, 0.1 retains 10%, and 0.01 retains 1% of base admission chances. Smaller values such as 0.005 can be entered directly without quotes or a percent sign. 0 disables this tier's ordinary natural spawns. It multiplies admission_chance in global.json and remains subject to day gates, terrain, density and other checks; all four ranks share this admission rule without an extra roamer roll. Automatic large battles use battle_admission_chance separately, not this multiplier. Reinforcement flares and hostile beacons are unaffected.
spawning._说明_first_spawn_day_中文: 本阶最早解锁的个人在线日，1–1000000；仍须超过全局safe_days。24000在线tick=1天；解锁不保证当日生成。
spawning._description_first_spawn_day_en: First eligible personal online day, 1–1000000; global safe_days also applies. 24000 online ticks = 1 day. Unlocking does not guarantee spawning.

ammunition._说明_中文: 首次生成时按实际持有弓弩/枪械配给，箭矢与弹匣数量分别在min和max之间随机。零可禁用该类初始补给；范围倒置会自动归正。箭矢上限1920，弹匣上限720；仅整数，非法值回退默认。满背包沿用装备保护与溢出掉落规则；加载旧存档、雇佣或补给不会重新配发。
ammunition._description_en: Initial reserves for actual owned bows/crossbows or firearms, chosen inclusively between min and max. Zero disables initial supplies; inverted bounds are normalized. Integers only, arrows capped at 1920 and magazines at 720; invalid values use defaults. Full inventories retain equipment protection and overflow drops. Loading saves, hiring or resupplying never grants another initial reserve.

arrows._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–1920整数；0允许不配发。
arrows._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–1920; zero allows no supply.
arrows._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–1920整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
arrows._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–1920; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.
arrows._说明_中文: 通用箭矢初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
arrows._description_en: Initial arrows for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.

magazines._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–720整数；0允许不配发。
magazines._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–720; zero allows no supply.
magazines._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–720整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
magazines._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–720; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.
magazines._说明_中文: 通用弹匣初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
magazines._description_en: Initial magazines for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.

potions._说明_中文: 仅生成时发放一次，受ai.item_recovery_enabled控制。count_min/max是含两端的瓶数(0至30)，不是堆叠量；恢复/战术池按weight独立抽取。空池不会补默认药水，缺失注册ID跳过；修改后重启，已有实体不补发。
potions._description_en: One-time spawn provisioning, gated by ai.item_recovery_enabled. Counts are inclusive bottle totals (0-30), not stack size. Weighted pools are independent; empty pools never spawn fallback potions and unavailable IDs are skipped. Restart to apply; existing entities are not replenished.
potions._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生药水发放开关；还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
potions._description_enabled_en: Spawn-potion switch for this rank; also requires ai.item_recovery_enabled.

recovery._说明_count_min_中文: 随机瓶数下限，0–30整数；不是单格堆叠上限。
recovery._description_count_min_en: Minimum bottle count, integer 0–30; not a per-slot stack limit.
recovery._说明_count_max_中文: 随机瓶数上限，0–30整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
recovery._description_count_max_en: Maximum bottle count, integer 0–30; inclusive, reversed bounds swapped.
recovery._说明_pool_中文: 候选列表：item为瓶形物品ID，potion为药水ID，weight为正权重。空列表不发药水，未注册ID跳过。
recovery._description_pool_en: Candidate list: item is bottle item ID, potion is potion ID, weight is positive relative weight. Empty lists grant none; unregistered IDs are skipped.

tactical._说明_count_min_中文: 随机瓶数下限，0–30整数；不是单格堆叠上限。
tactical._description_count_min_en: Minimum bottle count, integer 0–30; not a per-slot stack limit.
tactical._说明_count_max_中文: 随机瓶数上限，0–30整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
tactical._description_count_max_en: Maximum bottle count, integer 0–30; inclusive, reversed bounds swapped.
tactical._说明_pool_中文: 候选列表：item为瓶形物品ID，potion为药水ID，weight为正权重。空列表不发药水，未注册ID跳过。
tactical._description_pool_en: Candidate list: item is bottle item ID, potion is potion ID, weight is positive relative weight. Empty lists grant none; unregistered IDs are skipped.
tactical._说明_中文: 战术药水储备；额外迅捷药水计入此类数量。
tactical._description_en: Tactical potion reserves; bonus Speed potions count toward this total.

bonus._说明_中文: 该药水按chance抽取，成功加入时占用一个战术药水名额，不额外增加总数。chance=0关闭；战术数量为0时不发放。
bonus._description_en: Chance to reserve one tactical bottle for this potion; does not add to the tactical count. Set chance=0 to disable; a zero tactical count grants none.
bonus._说明_item_中文: 额外药水的瓶形物品ID；例如minecraft:potion。
bonus._description_item_en: Bottle item ID for the bonus potion, e.g. minecraft:potion.
bonus._description_potion_en: Registered bonus potion ID, e.g. minecraft:swiftness.
bonus._说明_chance_中文: 用额外药水替代一个战术瓶的概率，0–1；不会增加战术瓶总量。
bonus._description_chance_en: Chance to replace one tactical bottle, 0–1; does not increase the tactical total.

damage_multipliers._description_en: Outgoing multipliers multiply the matching global values in global.json; the default 1 makes no additional change. melee_damage_multiplier covers melee, including trident stabs; bow_damage_multiplier covers arrows from bows and crossbows; trident_damage_multiplier covers thrown tridents only. incoming_damage_multiplier belongs to the defender and scales damage received by this tier, including firearms and environmental damage; it is not an outgoing multiplier. Firearm output is configured in rank files or global.json.
damage_multipliers._说明_melee_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶近战输出倍率，0–10；乘全局近战倍率。
damage_multipliers._description_melee_damage_multiplier_en: Rank melee output multiplier, 0–10; multiplies global melee scaling.
damage_multipliers._说明_bow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弓/弩输出倍率，0–10；乘全局弓弩倍率。
damage_multipliers._description_bow_damage_multiplier_en: Rank bow/crossbow output multiplier, 0–10; multiplies global projectile scaling.
damage_multipliers._说明_trident_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶投掷三叉戟输出倍率，0–10；不用于近刺。
damage_multipliers._description_trident_damage_multiplier_e: Rank thrown-trident output multiplier, 0–10; excludes melee stabs.
damage_multipliers._说明_incoming_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶受到伤害的倍率，0–10；0可免除此层伤害，包括环境和枪伤。
damage_multipliers._description_incoming_damage_multiplier_: Incoming damage multiplier for this rank, 0–10; 0 suppresses this layer, including environment/firearms.

weapon_spread_degrees._说明_中文: 该阶每一种枪械和弹射武器的独立瞄准散布角度；数值越小越精准。
weapon_spread_degrees._description_en: Independent aiming spread angles for every firearm and projectile weapon used by this tier; lower values are more accurate.

firearms._说明_中文: 枪械分类散布。sniper=狙击枪，rifle=步枪，mg=机枪，pistol=手枪，smg=冲锋枪，shotgun=霰弹枪，other=其他/无法识别类型。
firearms._description_en: Firearm spread by category: sniper, rifle, mg (machine gun), pistol, smg, shotgun, and other (unrecognized types).

projectiles._说明_中文: 弹射武器散布。bow=弓，crossbow=弩，trident=三叉戟；三类可分别设置。
projectiles._description_en: Projectile spread: bow, crossbow and trident are configured independently.

combat._说明_中文: 近战攻击冷却随机范围，单位为游戏 tick（20 tick=1 秒）。
combat._description_en: Random melee attack cooldown range in game ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_min_中文: 近战随机冷却下限，1–200 tick；20 tick=1秒。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_min_en: Minimum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second.
combat._说明_melee_cooldown_max_中文: 近战随机冷却上限，1–200 tick；上下限倒置时自动交换。
combat._description_melee_cooldown_max_en: Maximum random melee cooldown, 1–200 ticks; reversed bounds are swapped.

spawning._说明_中文: spawn_multiplier 是本阶普通自然生成/区块初始自然生成的准入倍率，不是直接概率；允许 0–100 的整数或小数。相对于本项设为 1 时，0.5 保留 50%、0.1 保留 10%、0.01 保留 1% 的基础准入机会；可直接填写 0.005 等更小的数值，不加引号或百分号。0 禁止本阶普通自然生成。它与 global.json 的 admission_chance 相乘，仍受天数、地形、密度等条件限制；四阶使用相同准入规则，没有流浪者额外随机判定。自然大型战斗由 battle_admission_chance 单独控制，不乘此倍率；援军信号弹和敌对信标不受此项影响。
spawning._description_en: spawn_multiplier scales admission for this tier's ordinary and chunk-generation natural spawns; it is not a direct probability. Integers and decimals from 0 to 100 are accepted. Compared with setting this value to 1, 0.5 retains 50%, 0.1 retains 10%, and 0.01 retains 1% of base admission chances. Smaller values such as 0.005 can be entered directly without quotes or a percent sign. 0 disables this tier's ordinary natural spawns. It multiplies admission_chance in global.json and remains subject to day gates, terrain, density and other checks; all four ranks share this admission rule without an extra roamer roll. Automatic large battles use battle_admission_chance separately, not this multiplier. Reinforcement flares and hostile beacons are unaffected.
spawning._说明_first_spawn_day_中文: 本阶最早解锁的个人在线日，1–1000000；仍须超过全局safe_days。24000在线tick=1天；解锁不保证当日生成。
spawning._description_first_spawn_day_en: First eligible personal online day, 1–1000000; global safe_days also applies. 24000 online ticks = 1 day. Unlocking does not guarantee spawning.

ammunition._说明_中文: 首次生成时按实际持有弓弩/枪械配给，箭矢与弹匣数量分别在min和max之间随机。零可禁用该类初始补给；范围倒置会自动归正。箭矢上限1920，弹匣上限720；仅整数，非法值回退默认。满背包沿用装备保护与溢出掉落规则；加载旧存档、雇佣或补给不会重新配发。
ammunition._description_en: Initial reserves for actual owned bows/crossbows or firearms, chosen inclusively between min and max. Zero disables initial supplies; inverted bounds are normalized. Integers only, arrows capped at 1920 and magazines at 720; invalid values use defaults. Full inventories retain equipment protection and overflow drops. Loading saves, hiring or resupplying never grants another initial reserve.

arrows._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–1920整数；0允许不配发。
arrows._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–1920; zero allows no supply.
arrows._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–1920整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
arrows._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–1920; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.
arrows._说明_中文: 通用箭矢初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
arrows._description_en: Initial arrows for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.

magazines._说明_min_中文: 出生数量下限，0–720整数；0允许不配发。
magazines._description_min_en: Minimum initial count, integer 0–720; zero allows no supply.
magazines._说明_max_中文: 出生数量上限，0–720整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
magazines._description_max_en: Maximum initial count, integer 0–720; inclusive, with reversed bounds swapped.
magazines._说明_中文: 通用弹匣初始储备，只为对应远程职业生成；数量单位是个，不是组。
magazines._description_en: Initial magazines for matching ranged loadouts; counts are individual items, not stacks.

potions._说明_中文: 仅生成时发放一次，受ai.item_recovery_enabled控制。count_min/max是含两端的瓶数(0至30)，不是堆叠量；恢复/战术池按weight独立抽取。空池不会补默认药水，缺失注册ID跳过；修改后重启，已有实体不补发。
potions._description_en: One-time spawn provisioning, gated by ai.item_recovery_enabled. Counts are inclusive bottle totals (0-30), not stack size. Weighted pools are independent; empty pools never spawn fallback potions and unavailable IDs are skipped. Restart to apply; existing entities are not replenished.
potions._说明_enabled_中文: 本阶出生药水发放开关；还需本阶ai.item_recovery_enabled开启。
potions._description_enabled_en: Spawn-potion switch for this rank; also requires ai.item_recovery_enabled.

recovery._说明_count_min_中文: 随机瓶数下限，0–30整数；不是单格堆叠上限。
recovery._description_count_min_en: Minimum bottle count, integer 0–30; not a per-slot stack limit.
recovery._说明_count_max_中文: 随机瓶数上限，0–30整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
recovery._description_count_max_en: Maximum bottle count, integer 0–30; inclusive, reversed bounds swapped.
recovery._说明_pool_中文: 候选列表：item为瓶形物品ID，potion为药水ID，weight为正权重。空列表不发药水，未注册ID跳过。
recovery._description_pool_en: Candidate list: item is bottle item ID, potion is potion ID, weight is positive relative weight. Empty lists grant none; unregistered IDs are skipped.

tactical._说明_count_min_中文: 随机瓶数下限，0–30整数；不是单格堆叠上限。
tactical._description_count_min_en: Minimum bottle count, integer 0–30; not a per-slot stack limit.
tactical._说明_count_max_中文: 随机瓶数上限，0–30整数；包含两端，倒置范围自动交换。
tactical._description_count_max_en: Maximum bottle count, integer 0–30; inclusive, reversed bounds swapped.
tactical._说明_pool_中文: 候选列表：item为瓶形物品ID，potion为药水ID，weight为正权重。空列表不发药水，未注册ID跳过。
tactical._description_pool_en: Candidate list: item is bottle item ID, potion is potion ID, weight is positive relative weight. Empty lists grant none; unregistered IDs are skipped.
tactical._说明_中文: 战术药水储备；额外迅捷药水计入此类数量。
tactical._description_en: Tactical potion reserves; bonus Speed potions count toward this total.

bonus._说明_中文: 该药水按chance抽取，成功加入时占用一个战术药水名额，不额外增加总数。chance=0关闭；战术数量为0时不发放。
bonus._description_en: Chance to reserve one tactical bottle for this potion; does not add to the tactical count. Set chance=0 to disable; a zero tactical count grants none.
bonus._说明_item_中文: 额外药水的瓶形物品ID；例如minecraft:potion。
bonus._description_item_en: Bottle item ID for the bonus potion, e.g. minecraft:potion.
bonus._description_potion_en: Registered bonus potion ID, e.g. minecraft:swiftness.
bonus._说明_chance_中文: 用额外药水替代一个战术瓶的概率，0–1；不会增加战术瓶总量。
bonus._description_chance_en: Chance to replace one tactical bottle, 0–1; does not increase the tactical total.

tier2._说明_中文: 二阶人类专用配置：按属性→移动→战斗→生成与装备→弹药与药水→枪械→雇佣阅读。本文件只影响本阶；总开关在global.json。修改后完整重启，出生装备/补给不补发给已有实体。
tier2._description_en: tier2 settings: attributes, movement, combat, spawning/equipment, ammunition/potions, firearms, hiring. Applies only to this rank; master switches are in global.json. Restart to apply; spawn equipment/supplies are not reissued to existing entities.

attributes._说明_中文: 生命值范围以生命值点数计（2 点=1 颗心）；其余为实体基础属性。attack_damage 是基础近战攻击属性，不是伤害倍率或固定最终伤害，武器和状态效果仍可修改它；不参与弓、弩、投掷三叉戟和枪械伤害计算。实际近战伤害另乘全局和本阶近战倍率。
attributes._description_en: Health bounds use health points (2 points = 1 heart); the other values are base entity attributes. attack_damage is the base melee attack attribute, not a multiplier or fixed final damage; weapons and effects may still modify it. It is not used for bow, crossbow, thrown-trident or firearm damage. Actual melee damage also uses the global and tier melee multipliers.
attributes._说明_health_min_中文: 随机初始生命下限，范围1–1024点；2点=1颗心。
attributes._description_health_min_en: Minimum initial health, 1–1024 points; 2 points = 1 heart.
attributes._说明_health_max_中文: 随机初始生命上限，范围1–1024点；上下限倒置时自动交换。
attributes._description_health_max_en: Maximum initial health, 1–1024 points; reversed bounds are swapped.
attributes._说明_attack_damage_中文: 基础近战攻击属性，0–2048；装备、附魔和伤害倍率仍会继续计算。
attributes._description_attack_damage_en: Base melee attack attribute, 0–2048; equipment, enchantments and multipliers still apply.
attributes._说明_armor_中文: 基础护甲值，0–30；装备护甲另外计算。
attributes._description_armor_en: Base armor, 0–30; equipped armor adds separately.
attributes._说明_knockback_resistance_中文: 基础击退抗性，0–1；1表示完全抵抗常规击退。
attributes._description_knockback_resistance_en: Base knockback resistance, 0–1; 1 fully resists normal knockback.
attributes._说明_follow_range_中文: 目标探测属性，8–128格；不是雇佣跟随的启停距离。
attributes._description_follow_range_en: Target detection attribute, 8–128 blocks; not the hired-follow start/stop distance.

movement._说明_中文: 新速度公式的基础移动速度（默认 0.105，即普通玩家基础移速的 1.05 倍；可设 0.01–0.2）。疾跑与迅捷等状态效果沿用原版属性修正。
movement._description_en: Base movement attribute for the new speed formula (default 0.105, or 1.05x the normal player's base movement speed; range 0.01–0.2). Sprint and effects such as Speed use vanilla attribute modifiers.
movement._说明_base_speed_中文: 基础移速属性，0.01–0.2；默认0.105，保留原版疾跑及状态修正。
movement._description_base_speed_en: Base movement attribute, 0.01–0.2; default 0.105, with vanilla sprint/effect modifiers.
movement._说明_follow_speed_multiplier_中文: 闲置雇佣跟随导航倍率，0.1–3，默认1.35。

movement._description_follow_catch_up_multiplier_: Catch-up multiplier beyond 12 blocks, 0.1–3; default 1.6, never below normal follow.

attributes._说明_中文: 生命值范围以生命值点数计（2 点=1 颗心）；其余为实体基础属性。attack_damage 是基础近战攻击属性，不是伤害倍率或固定最终伤害，武器和状态效果仍可修改它；不参与弓、弩、投掷三叉戟和枪械伤害计算。实际近战伤害另乘全局和本阶近战倍率。
attributes._description_en: Health bounds use health points (2 points = 1 heart); the other values are base entity attributes. attack_damage is the base melee attack attribute, not a multiplier or fixed final damage; weapons and effects may still modify it. It is not used for bow, crossbow, thrown-trident or firearm damage. Actual melee damage also uses the global and tier melee multipliers.
attributes._说明_health_min_中文: 随机初始生命下限，范围1–1024点；2点=1颗心。
attributes._description_health_min_en: Minimum initial health, 1–1024 points; 2 points = 1 heart.
attributes._说明_health_max_中文: 随机初始生命上限，范围1–1024点；上下限倒置时自动交换。
attributes._description_health_max_en: Maximum initial health, 1–1024 points; reversed bounds are swapped.
attributes._说明_attack_damage_中文: 基础近战攻击属性，0–2048；装备、附魔和伤害倍率仍会继续计算。
attributes._description_attack_damage_en: Base melee attack attribute, 0–2048; equipment, enchantments and multipliers still apply.
attributes._说明_armor_中文: 基础护甲值，0–30；装备护甲另外计算。

movement._说明_中文: 新速度公式的基础移动速度（默认 0.105，即普通玩家基础移速的 1.05 倍；可设 0.01–0.2）。疾跑与迅捷等状态效果沿用原版属性修正。

movement._说明_base_speed_中文: 基础移速属性，0.01–0.2；默认0.105，保留原版疾跑及状态修正。
movement._description_base_speed_en: Base movement attribute, 0.01–0.2; default 0.105, with vanilla sprint/effect modifiers.

movement._说明_follow_catch_up_multiplier_中文: 距离主人超过12格的追赶倍率，0.1–3，默认1.6；不会低于普通跟随倍率。
movement._description_follow_catch_up_multiplier_: Catch-up multiplier beyond 12 blocks, 0.1–3; default 1.6, never below normal follow.
movement._说明_跟随_中文: 雇佣士兵无目标跟随的导航倍率：普通1.35，超过12格追赶1.6；超过6格疾跑，2.5格内停止，4格外重新启动。倍率0.1至3，仅影响跟随，不改变战斗/撤退/驻守。
movement._description_follow_en: Idle hired-follow navigation speed: 1.35 normally, 1.6 beyond 12 blocks; sprint beyond 6, stop within 2.5, restart beyond 4. Multipliers range 0.1-3; combat, retreat and guard are unchanged.

damage_multipliers._description_en: Outgoing multipliers multiply the matching global values in global.json; the default 1 makes no additional change. melee_damage_multiplier covers melee, including trident stabs; bow_damage_multiplier covers arrows from bows and crossbows; trident_damage_multiplier covers thrown tridents only. incoming_damage_multiplier belongs to the defender and scales damage received by this tier, including firearms and environmental damage; it is not an outgoing multiplier. Firearm output is configured in rank files or global.json.
damage_multipliers._说明_melee_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶近战输出倍率，0–10；乘全局近战倍率。
damage_multipliers._description_melee_damage_multiplier_en: Rank melee output multiplier, 0–10; multiplies global melee scaling.
damage_multipliers._说明_bow_damage_multiplier_中文: 本阶弓/弩输出倍率，0–10；乘全局弓弩倍率。

damage_multipliers._description_trident_damage_multiplier_e: Rank thrown-trident output multiplier, 0–10; excludes melee stabs.

damage_multipliers._description_incoming_damage_multiplier_: Incoming damage multiplier for this rank, 0–10; 0 suppresses this layer, including environment/firearms.

spawning._说明_中文: spawn_multiplier 是本阶普通自然生成/区块初始自然生成的准入倍率，不是直接概率；允许 0–100 的整数或小数。相对于本项设为 1 时，0.5 保留 50%、0.1 保留 10%、0.01 保留 1% 的基础准入机会；可直接填写 0.005 等更小的数值，不加引号或百分号。0 禁止本阶普通自然生成。它与 global.json 的 admission_chance 相乘，仍受天数、地形、密度等条件限制；四阶使用相同准入规则，没有流浪者额外随机判定。自然大型战斗由 battle_admission_chance 单独控制，不乘此倍率；援军信号弹和敌对信标不受此项影响。
spawning._description_en: spawn_multiplier scales admission for this tier's ordinary and chunk-generation natural spawns; it is not a direct probability. Integers and decimals from 0 to 100 are accepted. Compared with setting this value to 1, 0.5 retains 50%, 0.1 retains 10%, and 0.01 retains 1% of base admission chances. Smaller values such as 0.005 can be entered directly without quotes or a percent sign. 0 disables this tier's ordinary natural spawns. It multiplies admission_chance in global.json and remains subject to day gates, terrain, density and other checks; all four ranks share this admission rule without an extra roamer roll. Automatic large battles use battle_admission_chance separately, not this multiplier. Reinforcement flares and hostile beacons are unaffected.

spawning._description_first_spawn_day_en: First eligible personal online day, 1–1000000; global safe_days also applies. 24000 online ticks = 1 day. Unlocking does not guarantee spawning.

damage._说明_中文: 非枪械的全局输出倍率，与 对应阶级文件 中攻击者所属阶级的对应倍率相乘；不是覆盖值。每次命中只使用匹配的攻击类型，不把近战、箭矢、投掷三叉戟倍率全部乘在一起。各项只调整伤害，不调整攻击距离、射速或弹速。枪械输出另在 对应阶级文件或global.json。
damage._description_en: Global outgoing multipliers for non-firearm attacks multiply the corresponding attacker-tier values in the corresponding rank file; they are not overrides. Each hit uses its matching attack category, not all melee/arrow/thrown-trident multipliers together. These settings change damage, not reach, attack cadence or projectile speed. Firearm output is configured in rank files or global.json.
damage._说明_近战计算_中文: 普通近战输入伤害 × human_melee_damage_multiplier × 本阶 melee_damage_multiplier。输入伤害已经包含武器、攻击属性和附魔等原生计算；Better Combat 的连招/扫击按其攻击属性规则参与，不会替代这里的倍率。特殊近刺、跳斩和目标承伤倍率只在条件成立时继续相乘。
damage._description_melee_formula_en: Ordinary melee input damage × human_melee_damage_multiplier × tier melee_damage_multiplier. Input damage already includes native weapon, attack-attribute and enchantment calculations. Better Combat combo/sweep rules affect the attack attributes and do not replace these multipliers. Stab, jump-attack and defender multipliers apply additionally only when their conditions are met.
damage._说明_弹射物计算_中文: 弓/弩箭输入伤害 × human_bow_damage_multiplier × 本阶 bow_damage_multiplier × bow_velocity_damage_multiplier；投掷三叉戟输入伤害 × human_trident_damage_multiplier × 本阶 trident_damage_multiplier × trident_velocity_damage_multiplier。两个 velocity 项沿用历史名称，实际是额外常数伤害倍率，不读取或改变弹速。箭矢自身的原生伤害计算仍可包含速度。
damage._description_projectile_formula_en: Bow/crossbow arrow input damage × human_bow_damage_multiplier × tier bow_damage_multiplier × bow_velocity_damage_multiplier; thrown-trident input damage × human_trident_damage_multiplier × tier trident_damage_multiplier × trident_velocity_damage_multiplier. The two velocity keys retain historical names but are additional constant damage multipliers; they neither read nor change projectile speed. Native arrow damage may still depend on speed.
damage._说明_特殊修正_中文: trident_stab_damage_multiplier 仅额外修正手持三叉戟的近刺，仍使用近战全局/阶级倍率，不使用投掷三叉戟倍率。jump_attack_damage_multiplier 仅用于条件成立的下落跳斩。tamed_maid_melee_damage_multiplier 仅额外修正人类对已驯服女仆的近战伤害，不控制女仆对人类的伤害。这些值以及目标减伤、护甲和其他模组的修改会共同影响最终扣血，因此上述公式不是保证的最终生命损失。

equipment_integration._说明_中文: 武器装备自动导入总开关。只控制启动时是否向装备池追加已安装模组的默认联动装备，不控制动画兼容和物品使用。修改后重启生效。
equipment_integration._description_en: Master switch for startup equipment imports. Controls additive discovery of default equipment from installed mods, not animations or item use. Restart to apply.
equipment_integration._说明_auto_import_enabled_中文: 默认true。开启时按阶追加首次导入的斯巴达武器/盾牌及沉浸式盔甲套装，保留自定义条目及其权重、空池和已有导入记录；关闭后不追加或改写装备池，也不删除已有条目。分阶automatic_spartan_weapons/shields及automatic_immersive_armors仍分别控制导入。
equipment_integration._description_auto_import_enabled_en: Default true. Add first-time Spartan weapon/shield and Immersive Armors imports by rank while preserving custom rows/weights, empty pools and receipts. False prevents pool imports/writes without removing existing rows. Per-rank Spartan and Immersive Armors switches still apply.

equipment_loadouts._说明_中文: 四阶生成装备的唯一配置入口：roamer=流浪者，tier1=一阶，tier2=二阶，tier3=三阶。位于 config/hostile_humans_unified/<rank>.json: equipment_loadout。只影响之后生成的人类，已有实体和主人手动放入的物品不重置。修改后重启游戏/服务器；/reload 不重读本配置。旧数据包 human_loadouts 已停止读取，不会自动迁移第三方数据包的自定义条目，需手动填入这里。
equipment_loadouts._description_en: The sole spawn-loadout config for roamer and tier1-3, in config/hostile_humans_unified/<rank>.json: equipment_loadout. Applies only to future spawns, never resets existing entities or owner-supplied items. Restart the game/server to apply; /reload does not reload these settings. The old human_loadouts datapack loader is removed; third-party datapack customizations must be copied here manually.
equipment_loadouts._说明_格式_中文: 数组里的每一项用花括号，物品用完整 item ID 字符串，例如 {"item":"minecraft:iron_sword","weight":3} 与 {"item":"spartanweaponry:iron_longsword","weight":1,"requires_mod":"spartanweaponry"}；两项之间用逗号。所有 ID/键使用双引号，数量、权重和概率不加引号。weight 为 0 至 1000000 的整数，0 禁用，正数按可用条目的相对权重分配，不必合计 100。count 可选，默认 1，范围 1-64 并限制到物品最大堆叠数。requires_mod 可选。未安装的模组物品会跳过；非法 ID 条目启动时告警并跳过。说明文本中的 \" 是 JSON 字符串转义，实际 item 字段只写 "minecraft:iron_sword"，不要把反斜杠复制到 ID 里。
equipment_loadouts._description_format_en: Each array row is an object, e.g. {"item":"minecraft:iron_sword","weight":3} and {"item":"spartanweaponry:iron_longsword","weight":1,"requires_mod":"spartanweaponry"}, separated by commas. Quote keys/IDs, not numbers. weight is an integer 0-1000000; 0 disables a row. Positive weights are relative among available rows and need not sum to 100. Optional count defaults to 1, accepts 1-64 and is capped at the item's maximum stack size. Optional requires_mod gates a row. Missing mod items are skipped; malformed ID rows are warned and skipped at startup. Backslash-escaped quotes inside these description strings are JSON syntax: the actual item field is "minecraft:iron_sword", without backslashes in the ID.
equipment_loadouts._说明_池_中文: mainhand=普通主手池；ranged_mainhand=支持的非枪械远程池；inventory=备用近战池，供远程备用与额外武器名额抽取；offhand.chance/entries=副手概率和池；bonus_mainhand.chance/entries=额外武器名额选择奖励池的概率和池，不替换主手。武器每条生成 1 把，数量统一受本阶上限控制。armor_sets 按权重选整套，head/chest/legs/feet 为四部位 ID，省略或 null 表示不穿，空数组表示不生成护甲。任一填写部位不存在或不匹配则跳过整套。主手/远程池全部失效仍使用安全武器，但空备用池不制造额外武器。
equipment_loadouts._description_pools_en: mainhand is the ordinary weapon pool; ranged_mainhand accepts supported non-firearm ranged weapons; inventory supplies melee backups and extra weapon slots. offhand.chance/entries control offhand rolls. bonus_mainhand.chance/entries select a bonus pool for an extra slot, never replace the main hand. Each weapon entry generates one weapon within the rank cap. armor_sets chooses a whole weighted set; head/chest/legs/feet are item IDs, omitted/null means unequipped and [] means no armor. Missing or wrong-slot items reject the whole set. Unavailable primary/ranged pools use a safe weapon, but an empty reserve pool does not manufacture extras.
equipment_loadouts._说明_远程与盾牌_中文: ranged_chance 为 0-1 的非枪械远程概率，默认 0.2/0.4/0.7/1；枪械判定成功时保留枪械和近战，不再额外补弓弩。ranged_in_backpack=true 将远程放背包，数量计入本阶上限。guaranteed_shields_min/max 为 0-3 的总盾牌数量目标，含手与背包；缺少时只从 shield_pool 抽取，空池或无有效条目就不补充，不回退到原版盾牌。禁止所有盾牌时同时清空 shield_pool 与 offhand.entries 中的盾牌条目。
equipment_loadouts._description_ranged_shields_en: ranged_chance is a 0-1 non-firearm ranged chance, defaulting to 0.2/0.4/0.7/1. A successful gun roll retains a gun and melee weapon instead of adding another bow/crossbow. ranged_in_backpack stores the ranged item; it counts toward the rank cap. guaranteed_shields_min/max target 0-3 total equipped/stored shields. Shortages only draw from shield_pool; empty/unavailable pools do not create a vanilla fallback. To disable all shields, clear shield_pool and remove shield rows from offhand.entries.
equipment_loadouts._说明_优先级与联动_中文: 斯巴达武器/盾牌不再在生成后替换装备。automatic_spartan_weapons/shields 仅控制启动时首次导入：识别已安装模组的可用条目后写入对应配置池，以 weight 抽取；_imported_spartanweaponry/_imported_spartanshields 为导入记录，保留记录即可让删除的条目不再补回。关闭导入开关不删除已经写入的条目，要禁止生成某装备请从池中删除或把 weight 设为 0。护甲只读取 armor_sets；requires_mod 可省略，物品不存在仍会跳过。删除数组内条目或保留空数组可以完全自定义，不要删除整个配置键。TaCZ 是额外携带机会，保留普通近战装备，枪械型号与概率读取 对应阶级文件或global.json；不要把 tacz:modern_kinetic_gun 当作型号写入物品池。自然装备成长最后处理，固定品质请关闭 equipment_growth.enabled。
equipment_loadouts._description_priority_en: Spartan gear never replaces generated equipment. automatic_spartan_weapons/shields only enable first-time startup import of registered compatible items into weighted pools. Keep _imported_spartanweaponry/_imported_spartanshields receipts so deleted rows stay deleted. Disabling import does not remove existing rows: delete a row or set its weight to 0 to stop its generation. Armor reads armor_sets only. requires_mod is optional; missing items are still skipped. Replace array contents or keep empty arrays for customization; do not delete entire keys. TaCZ is an extra carried firearm chance while keeping melee gear; gun IDs/chances remain in rank files or global.json, not the generic tacz:modern_kinetic_gun item. Natural growth runs last; disable equipment_growth.enabled for fixed quality.
equipment_loadouts._说明_武器数量_中文: 生成携带上限包含主手、副手和背包中的近战、弓弩、三叉戟、枪械：流浪者 2 把，其他三阶 3 把。weapon_count.second_weapon_chance 默认 0.45，第三把在第二把判定成功后以 third_weapon_chance 默认 0.20 再判定；近战默认数量概率为 1 把 55%、2 把 36%、3 把 9%，流浪者为 1 把 55%、2 把 45%。概率可配置 0-0.49，确保多把更少见。远程单位的近战备用占一个名额，枪手至少保留枪械与近战两把。bonus_mainhand 仅参与额外名额的抽取，不再替换主手。数量只在生成时限制，不限制以后拾取或主人配装。
equipment_loadouts._description_weapon_count_en: Spawn-only caps count weapons in both hands and the backpack: Roamers 2, other ranks 3, including melee, bows/crossbows, tridents and guns. second_weapon_chance defaults to 0.45; after success, third_weapon_chance defaults to 0.20. Ordinary melee counts are 55%/36%/9% for 1/2/3 weapons, or 55%/45% for Roamers. Chances accept 0-0.49 to keep larger counts rarer. Ranged melee backups count toward the cap; gunners retain at least a gun and melee weapon. bonus_mainhand participates in extra slots, never replaces the main hand. Later looting/owner equipment is not capped.
equipment_loadouts._说明_附魔_中文: rules.enchant_chance 为基础随机附魔概率；damage_percent_min/max 为生成时已损耗耐久比例（0=全新，0.85=最多损耗85%）；elite_enchantments 启用原三阶强化附魔预设，默认仅三阶 true。物品池条目可额外填写 enchantments 对象，例如 {"minecraft:unbreaking":3,"minecraft:sharpness":4}，等级为 1-255 的整数；只接受存在且适用于该物品的附魔，明确填写的等级在随机主手附魔后应用。automatic_shield_enchantments 控制额外按阶随机盾牌附魔，默认 true。若要仅使用自己指定的附魔，设 enchant_chance=0、elite_enchantments=false、automatic_shield_enchantments=false，并关闭自动斯巴达装备（其生成仍带自身附魔）。成长启用时最后仍会削弱附魔。
equipment_loadouts._description_enchantments_en: rules.enchant_chance controls base random enchanting; damage_percent_min/max are the fraction of durability already consumed at spawn (0=fresh, 0.85=up to 85% worn). elite_enchantments enables the original elite enchantment preset, default true only for tier3. Item rows may include enchantments such as {"minecraft:unbreaking":3,"minecraft:sharpness":4}; integer levels 1-255, registered/applicable enchantments only. Explicit levels are applied after random main-hand enchanting. automatic_shield_enchantments controls the additional rank-specific shield enchantment pass, default true. For explicit-only enchantments use enchant_chance=0, elite_enchantments=false, automatic_shield_enchantments=false and disable automatic Spartan gear (it brings its own enchantments). Growth, if enabled, can still reduce enchantments afterward.

roamer._description_mainhand_en: Melee main-hand pool; select one using positive relative weights.

roamer._description_ranged_mainhand_en: Bow/crossbow main-hand pool; firearm generation is configured separately.

roamer._description_inventory_en: Backpack backup-weapon pool; existing count rules apply.
roamer._说明_bonus_mainhand_中文: 额外武器槽候选：chance为0–1概率，entries为权重池；不替换已生成主手。
roamer._description_bonus_mainhand_en: Bonus weapon-slot selection: chance 0–1 and weighted entries; does not replace the generated main hand.
roamer._说明_护甲_中文: 流浪者默认护甲权重：皮革 6、锁链 3、铁 1，即 60%/30%/10%，不默认生成钻石或高档联动护甲。新版本仅自动迁移完全未修改的旧默认护甲池，保留自定义内容；只影响之后生成的单位，不剥除现有装备或限制战利品拾取。
roamer._description_armor_en: Default Roamer armor weights: leather 6, chainmail 3, iron 1 (60%/30%/10%); no default diamond or high-end integration armor. Only the exact unmodified former default pool is migrated; custom pools remain intact. Applies to future spawns, without stripping existing gear or restricting loot pickup.
roamer._说明_armor_sets_中文: 整套护甲池：weight为正权重，head/chest/legs/feet为各部位物品ID；requires_mod可限定前置。
roamer._description_armor_sets_en: Armor-set pool: positive weight, head/chest/legs/feet item IDs; optional requires_mod dependency.
roamer._说明_ranged_chance_中文: 非枪械远程武器生成概率，0–1；枪械已抽中时不额外补弓弩。
roamer._description_ranged_chance_en: Non-firearm ranged weapon chance, 0–1; successful firearm rolls do not add bows/crossbows.
roamer._说明_ranged_in_backpack_中文: 将生成的非枪械远程武器放入背包，而不是主手；仍计入武器数量上限。
roamer._description_ranged_in_backpack_en: Place non-firearm ranged weapons in the backpack instead of the main hand; still counts toward the weapon cap.
roamer._说明_automatic_immersive_armors_中文: 是否首次自动导入本阶默认沉浸式盔甲套装；受全局equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled控制，保留自定义套装、权重、空池和导入记录。
roamer._description_automatic_immersive_armors_: Import this rank's default Immersive Armors sets once under the global equipment integration switch, preserving custom sets/weights, empty pools and receipts.
roamer._说明_automatic_spartan_weapons_中文: 是否自动导入可用斯巴达武器；受全局equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled控制；启动注册表就绪后追加并备份，保留自定义条目/权重，空池及已有导入记录不补回。
roamer._description_automatic_spartan_weapons_e: Import available Spartan weapons additively once registries are ready, under the global equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled switch. Back up existing files and preserve custom entries/weights, empty pools and completed imports.
roamer._说明_automatic_spartan_shields_中文: 是否自动导入可用斯巴达盾牌；受全局equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled控制；启动注册表就绪后追加并备份，保留自定义条目/权重，空池及已有导入记录不补回。
roamer._description_automatic_spartan_shields_e: Import available Spartan shields additively once registries are ready, under the global equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled switch. Back up existing files and preserve custom entries/weights, empty pools and completed imports.
roamer._说明_allow_tacz_firearms_中文: 允许本阶自动配枪；关闭后仍可由玩家手动配枪，不关闭全局TaCZ兼容。
roamer._description_allow_tacz_firearms_en: Allow automatic firearm provisioning for this rank; players can still supply guns, and global TaCZ integration remains.
roamer._说明_automatic_shield_enchantments_中文: 允许出生盾牌自动附魔；条目中指定的附魔仍按装备规则。
roamer._description_automatic_shield_enchantmen: Allow automatic enchantments on spawn shields; explicit entry enchantments follow loadout rules.
roamer._说明_guaranteed_shields_min_中文: 生成时盾牌总数目标下限，0–3，含手持与背包；仅从shield_pool补足。
roamer._description_guaranteed_shields_min_en: Minimum spawn shield-count target, 0–3, including hands/backpack; supplied only from shield_pool.
roamer._说明_guaranteed_shields_max_中文: 盾牌总数目标上限，0–3；空或无效shield_pool不补原版回退盾牌。
roamer._description_guaranteed_shields_max_en: Maximum shield-count target, 0–3; empty/invalid shield_pool does not produce fallback vanilla shields.
roamer._说明_shield_pool_中文: 盾牌候选权重池；须使用合法盾牌ID，空列表不保证盾牌。
roamer._description_shield_pool_en: Weighted shield pool; use valid shield IDs. An empty list guarantees no additional shields.

tier1._说明_中文: 本阶出生装备池。正权重按相对值抽取；不可用主手池使用安全回退，空备用池不补额外武器，armor_sets=[]不配护甲。枪械生成见本阶tacz。
tier1._description_en: Rank spawn loadouts. Positive weights are relative. Unavailable primary pools use safe fallbacks; empty reserve pools grant no extras; armor_sets=[] grants no armor. Firearms are configured in rank tacz.
tier1._说明_格式_中文: 数组里的每一项用花括号，物品用完整 item ID 字符串，例如 {"item":"minecraft:iron_sword","weight":3} 与 {"item":"spartanweaponry:iron_longsword","weight":1,"requires_mod":"spartanweaponry"}；两项之间用逗号。所有 ID/键使用双引号，数量、权重和概率不加引号。weight 为 0 至 1000000 的整数，0 禁用，正数按可用条目的相对权重分配，不必合计 100。count 可选，默认 1，范围 1-64 并限制到物品最大堆叠数。requires_mod 可选。未安装的模组物品会跳过；非法 ID 条目启动时告警并跳过。说明文本中的 \" 是 JSON 字符串转义，实际 item 字段只写 "minecraft:iron_sword"，不要把反斜杠复制到 ID 里。
tier1._description_format_en: Each array row is an object, e.g. {"item":"minecraft:iron_sword","weight":3} and {"item":"spartanweaponry:iron_longsword","weight":1,"requires_mod":"spartanweaponry"}, separated by commas. Quote keys/IDs, not numbers. weight is an integer 0-1000000; 0 disables a row. Positive weights are relative among available rows and need not sum to 100. Optional count defaults to 1, accepts 1-64 and is capped at the item's maximum stack size. Optional requires_mod gates a row. Missing mod items are skipped; malformed ID rows are warned and skipped at startup. Backslash-escaped quotes inside these description strings are JSON syntax: the actual item field is "minecraft:iron_sword", without backslashes in the ID.
tier1._说明_池_中文: mainhand=普通主手池；ranged_mainhand=支持的非枪械远程池；inventory=备用近战池，供远程备用与额外武器名额抽取；offhand.chance/entries=副手概率和池；bonus_mainhand.chance/entries=额外武器名额选择奖励池的概率和池，不替换主手。武器每条生成 1 把，数量统一受本阶上限控制。armor_sets 按权重选整套，head/chest/legs/feet 为四部位 ID，省略或 null 表示不穿，空数组表示不生成护甲。任一填写部位不存在或不匹配则跳过整套。主手/远程池全部失效仍使用安全武器，但空备用池不制造额外武器。
tier1._description_pools_en: mainhand is the ordinary weapon pool; ranged_mainhand accepts supported non-firearm ranged weapons; inventory supplies melee backups and extra weapon slots. offhand.chance/entries control offhand rolls. bonus_mainhand.chance/entries select a bonus pool for an extra slot, never replace the main hand. Each weapon entry generates one weapon within the rank cap. armor_sets chooses a whole weighted set; head/chest/legs/feet are item IDs, omitted/null means unequipped and [] means no armor. Missing or wrong-slot items reject the whole set. Unavailable primary/ranged pools use a safe weapon, but an empty reserve pool does not manufacture extras.
tier1._说明_远程与盾牌_中文: ranged_chance 为 0-1 的非枪械远程概率，默认 0.2/0.4/0.7/1；枪械判定成功时保留枪械和近战，不再额外补弓弩。ranged_in_backpack=true 将远程放背包，数量计入本阶上限。guaranteed_shields_min/max 为 0-3 的总盾牌数量目标，含手与背包；缺少时只从 shield_pool 抽取，空池或无有效条目就不补充，不回退到原版盾牌。禁止所有盾牌时同时清空 shield_pool 与 offhand.entries 中的盾牌条目。
tier1._description_ranged_shields_en: ranged_chance is a 0-1 non-firearm ranged chance, defaulting to 0.2/0.4/0.7/1. A successful gun roll retains a gun and melee weapon instead of adding another bow/crossbow. ranged_in_backpack stores the ranged item; it counts toward the rank cap. guaranteed_shields_min/max target 0-3 total equipped/stored shields. Shortages only draw from shield_pool; empty/unavailable pools do not create a vanilla fallback. To disable all shields, clear shield_pool and remove shield rows from offhand.entries.
tier1._说明_优先级与联动_中文: 斯巴达武器/盾牌不再在生成后替换装备。automatic_spartan_weapons/shields 仅控制启动时首次导入：识别已安装模组的可用条目后写入对应配置池，以 weight 抽取；_imported_spartanweaponry/_imported_spartanshields 为导入记录，保留记录即可让删除的条目不再补回。关闭导入开关不删除已经写入的条目，要禁止生成某装备请从池中删除或把 weight 设为 0。护甲只读取 armor_sets；requires_mod 可省略，物品不存在仍会跳过。删除数组内条目或保留空数组可以完全自定义，不要删除整个配置键。TaCZ 是额外携带机会，保留普通近战装备，枪械型号与概率读取 对应阶级文件或global.json；不要把 tacz:modern_kinetic_gun 当作型号写入物品池。自然装备成长最后处理，固定品质请关闭 equipment_growth.enabled。
tier1._description_priority_en: Spartan gear never replaces generated equipment. automatic_spartan_weapons/shields only enable first-time startup import of registered compatible items into weighted pools. Keep _imported_spartanweaponry/_imported_spartanshields receipts so deleted rows stay deleted. Disabling import does not remove existing rows: delete a row or set its weight to 0 to stop its generation. Armor reads armor_sets only. requires_mod is optional; missing items are still skipped. Replace array contents or keep empty arrays for customization; do not delete entire keys. TaCZ is an extra carried firearm chance while keeping melee gear; gun IDs/chances remain in rank files or global.json, not the generic tacz:modern_kinetic_gun item. Natural growth runs last; disable equipment_growth.enabled for fixed quality.
tier1._说明_武器数量_中文: 生成携带上限包含主手、副手和背包中的近战、弓弩、三叉戟、枪械：流浪者 2 把，其他三阶 3 把。weapon_count.second_weapon_chance 默认 0.45，第三把在第二把判定成功后以 third_weapon_chance 默认 0.20 再判定；近战默认数量概率为 1 把 55%、2 把 36%、3 把 9%，流浪者为 1 把 55%、2 把 45%。概率可配置 0-0.49，确保多把更少见。远程单位的近战备用占一个名额，枪手至少保留枪械与近战两把。bonus_mainhand 仅参与额外名额的抽取，不再替换主手。数量只在生成时限制，不限制以后拾取或主人配装。
tier1._description_weapon_count_en: Spawn-only caps count weapons in both hands and the backpack: Roamers 2, other ranks 3, including melee, bows/crossbows, tridents and guns. second_weapon_chance defaults to 0.45; after success, third_weapon_chance defaults to 0.20. Ordinary melee counts are 55%/36%/9% for 1/2/3 weapons, or 55%/45% for Roamers. Chances accept 0-0.49 to keep larger counts rarer. Ranged melee backups count toward the cap; gunners retain at least a gun and melee weapon. bonus_mainhand participates in extra slots, never replaces the main hand. Later looting/owner equipment is not capped.
tier1._说明_附魔_中文: rules.enchant_chance 为基础随机附魔概率；damage_percent_min/max 为生成时已损耗耐久比例（0=全新，0.85=最多损耗85%）；elite_enchantments 启用原三阶强化附魔预设，默认仅三阶 true。物品池条目可额外填写 enchantments 对象，例如 {"minecraft:unbreaking":3,"minecraft:sharpness":4}，等级为 1-255 的整数；只接受存在且适用于该物品的附魔，明确填写的等级在随机主手附魔后应用。automatic_shield_enchantments 控制额外按阶随机盾牌附魔，默认 true。若要仅使用自己指定的附魔，设 enchant_chance=0、elite_enchantments=false、automatic_shield_enchantments=false，并关闭自动斯巴达装备（其生成仍带自身附魔）。成长启用时最后仍会削弱附魔。
tier1._description_enchantments_en: rules.enchant_chance controls base random enchanting; damage_percent_min/max are the fraction of durability already consumed at spawn (0=fresh, 0.85=up to 85% worn). elite_enchantments enables the original elite enchantment preset, default true only for tier3. Item rows may include enchantments such as {"minecraft:unbreaking":3,"minecraft:sharpness":4}; integer levels 1-255, registered/applicable enchantments only. Explicit levels are applied after random main-hand enchanting. automatic_shield_enchantments controls the additional rank-specific shield enchantment pass, default true. For explicit-only enchantments use enchant_chance=0, elite_enchantments=false, automatic_shield_enchantments=false and disable automatic Spartan gear (it brings its own enchantments). Growth, if enabled, can still reduce enchantments afterward.
tier1._说明_rules_中文: 装备附魔与耐久的共用生成规则。

rules._说明_enchant_chance_中文: 装备获得自动附魔的概率，0–1；具体条目附魔仍按装备池规则。
rules._description_enchant_chance_en: Chance of automatic equipment enchantment, 0–1; entry enchantments follow pool rules.
rules._说明_damage_percent_min_中文: 初始耐久损耗比例下限，0–1；0表示未损耗。
rules._description_damage_percent_min_en: Minimum initial durability damage ratio, 0–1; 0 is undamaged.
rules._说明_damage_percent_max_中文: 初始耐久损耗比例上限，0–1。
rules._说明_elite_enchantments_中文: 是否允许本阶装备使用精英附魔规则。
rules._description_elite_enchantments_en: Allow elite enchantment rules for this rank.

tier3._description_format_en: Each array row is an object, e.g. {"item":"minecraft:iron_sword","weight":3} and {"item":"spartanweaponry:iron_longsword","weight":1,"requires_mod":"spartanweaponry"}, separated by commas. tier3._说明_armor_sets_中文: 整套护甲池：weight为正权重，head/chest/legs/feet为各部位物品ID；requires_mod可限定前置。
tier3._description_armor_sets_en: Armor-set pool: positive weight, head/chest/legs/feet item IDs; optional requires_mod dependency.
tier3._说明_ranged_chance_中文: 非枪械远程武器生成概率，0–1；枪械已抽中时不额外补弓弩。
tier3._description_ranged_chance_en: Non-firearm ranged weapon chance, 0–1; successful firearm rolls do not add bows/crossbows.
tier3._说明_ranged_in_backpack_中文: 将生成的非枪械远程武器放入背包，而不是主手；仍计入武器数量上限。
tier3._description_ranged_in_backpack_en: Place non-firearm ranged weapons in the backpack instead of the main hand; still counts toward the weapon cap.
tier3._说明_automatic_immersive_armors_中文: 是否首次自动导入本阶默认沉浸式盔甲套装；受全局equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled控制，保留自定义套装、权重、空池和导入记录。
tier3._description_automatic_immersive_armors_: Import this rank's default Immersive Armors sets once under the global equipment integration switch, preserving custom sets/weights, empty pools and receipts.
tier3._说明_automatic_spartan_weapons_中文: 是否自动导入可用斯巴达武器；受全局equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled控制；启动注册表就绪后追加并备份，保留自定义条目/权重，空池及已有导入记录不补回。
tier3._description_automatic_spartan_weapons_e: Import available Spartan weapons additively once registries are ready, under the global equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled switch. Back up existing files and preserve custom entries/weights, empty pools and completed imports.
tier3._说明_automatic_spartan_shields_中文: 是否自动导入可用斯巴达盾牌；受全局equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled控制；启动注册表就绪后追加并备份，保留自定义条目/权重，空池及已有导入记录不补回。
tier3._description_automatic_spartan_shields_e: Import available Spartan shields additively once registries are ready, under the global equipment_integration.auto_import_enabled switch. Back up existing files and preserve custom entries/weights, empty pools and completed imports.
tier3._说明_allow_tacz_firearms_中文: 允许本阶自动配枪；关闭后仍可由玩家手动配枪，不关闭全局TaCZ兼容。
tier3._description_allow_tacz_firearms_en: Allow automatic firearm provisioning for this rank; players can still supply guns, and global TaCZ integration remains.
tier3._说明_automatic_shield_enchantments_中文: 允许出生盾牌自动附魔；条目中指定的附魔仍按装备规则。
tier3._description_automatic_shield_enchantmen: Allow automatic enchantments on spawn shields; explicit entry enchantments follow loadout rules.
tier3._说明_guaranteed_shields_min_中文: 生成时盾牌总数目标下限，0–3，含手持与背包；仅从shield_pool补足。
tier3._description_guaranteed_shields_min_en: Minimum spawn shield-count target, 0–3, including hands/backpack; supplied only from shield_pool.
tier3._说明_guaranteed_shields_max_中文: 盾牌总数目标上限，0–3；空或无效shield_pool不补原版回退盾牌。
tier3._description_guaranteed_shields_max_en: Maximum shield-count target, 0–3; empty/invalid shield_pool does not produce fallback vanilla shields.
tier3._说明_shield_pool_中文: 盾牌候选权重池；须使用合法盾牌ID，空列表不保证盾牌。
tier3._description_shield_pool_en: Weighted shield pool; use valid shield IDs. An empty list guarantees no additional shields.

equipment_growth._说明_中文: 自然生成装备成长总开关，默认开启。仅作用于新自然生成、区块初始自然生成和自然大型战斗的人类；已有实体、玩家装备、援军信号弹、敌对信标、刷怪蛋和命令生成不变。关闭 enabled 后新生成的人类完全使用原有装备规则，不自动恢复已经生成的早期装备。只影响初始装备，不修改血量、基础伤害倍率、阶级和原有弓弩携带概率；装备和附魔变化仍会影响实际战斗表现。修改后重启生效，不重置已有配置。
equipment_growth._description_en: Enabled by default. Applies only to newly naturally spawned humans, initial chunk-population spawns and automatic battles. Existing entities, owner-supplied gear, friendly flares, hostile beacons, spawn eggs and commands are unchanged. Disabling enabled gives new humans the original loadout rules; it does not restore early gear already generated. Only initial gear is affected, not base health, configured damage multipliers, rank or existing bow/crossbow probabilities; changed gear and enchantments still affect combat strength. Restart to apply; existing configuration is preserved.
equipment_growth._说明_成长公式_中文: 每阶进度 p=限制到 0–1 的 (个人在线日-start_day)/(full_quality_day-start_day)。采用生成点同维度最近的存活非旁观玩家的累计在线时间，与自然生成解锁共用个人计时；24000 个在线游戏 tick 为一天，离线、暂停、睡觉跳夜和 /time 不增加进度。start_day 只控制装备成长；解锁日在本阶 spawning.first_spawn_day 配置。结束日不晚于起点时，从结束日起使用完整装备。进度只在生成时保存，不会每天给已有实体换装。
equipment_growth._description_progress_formula_en: Per-tier p=clamp((personal online day-start_day)/(full_quality_day-start_day),0,1). Uses the nearest living non-spectator player's accumulated online time in the spawn dimension, shared with rank unlocks. A day is 24000 online game ticks; offline time, pauses, skipped nights and /time do not advance it. start_day controls equipment only; rank spawning.first_spawn_day controls unlock dates. If the end is at/before the start, full gear applies from the end. Captured at spawn; existing humans are not re-equipped daily.
equipment_growth._说明_品质与枪械_中文: 所有 early_* 概率/倍率允许 0–1 小数，实际值=早期值+(1-早期值)×p。early_baseline_gear_chance 是保留本阶原有装备材质的概率，同一实体共用材质判定；否则使用 early_melee、early_armor 和 early_spartan_material。早期材质不会提升本就更弱的默认装备。early_gun_chance_multiplier 乘 本阶 tacz.gun_chance：例如原概率 0.8、早期倍率 0.25，则起点概率 0.2；枪械 ID、类型权重和伤害不变。默认本阶原有装备品质达到日依次为 40、50、70、80。
equipment_growth._description_quality_and_guns_en: All early_* chances/multipliers accept decimals 0–1; the actual value is early+(1-early)×p. early_baseline_gear_chance preserves original material quality, with one shared material roll per human; otherwise early_melee, early_armor and early_spartan_material are used. Early substitutions do not upgrade weaker baseline gear. early_gun_chance_multiplier multiplies the rank tacz.gun_chance: 0.8×0.25=0.2 at the start. Gun IDs, type weights and damage are unchanged. Default baseline-quality days are 40, 50, 70 and 80.
equipment_growth._说明_附魔与特殊物品_中文: early_enchantment_keep_chance 是每个非诅咒附魔的保留概率；early_enchantment_level_multiplier 乘原等级并向下取整，结果 0 时去除该附魔；例如等级 IV×0.25=I。诅咒保留，替换物品只接受其可用附魔。盾牌与背包备用装备也处理。early_totem_keep_chance 控制已抽中的不死图腾保留概率；early_trident_keep_chance 控制已抽中的三叉戟保留概率，不保留时替换为弓以保留远程能力。到结束日不再过滤任何装备和附魔。食物、药水等补给不受影响。
equipment_growth._description_enchantments_and_specials_e: early_enchantment_keep_chance retains each non-curse enchantment; early_enchantment_level_multiplier multiplies its original level and rounds down, removing levels that become 0. Level IV×0.25=I. Curses remain; replacement items accept only applicable enchantments. Shields and backpack backups are included. early_totem_keep_chance retains already-rolled totems. early_trident_keep_chance retains already-rolled tridents; otherwise a bow preserves ranged capability. On the end day, gear/enchantments are no longer filtered. Food and potion supplies are unchanged.
equipment_growth._说明_物品ID_中文: early_melee.sword/axe 和 early_armor.head/chest/legs/feet 接受原版或模组的完整物品 ID 字符串，例如 "minecraft:iron_sword"、"immersive_armors:wooden_chestplate"；ID 使用双引号，JSON 各项用逗号分隔。未安装、无效 ID、air 或不符合部位/武器类型的 ID 使用安全回退装备，控制台对每个无效 ID 仅警告一次。early_spartan_material 指斯巴达注册名的材质前缀，例如 wooden、stone、copper、iron、diamond；尽量保留武器类型，无对应物品则回退早期原版近战武器、弓/弩或盾牌。不能靠材质前缀评定任意枪械的强弱，因此枪械只调整生成概率。如本说明中的引号以反斜杠转义显示，真实物品 ID 配置需移除转义反斜杠，只保留包裹字符串的双引号。
equipment_growth._description_item_ids_en: early_melee.sword/axe and early_armor.head/chest/legs/feet accept full vanilla/mod item IDs such as "minecraft:iron_sword" or "immersive_armors:wooden_chestplate". Use double-quoted strings and commas between JSON entries. Missing, invalid, air or wrong slot/weapon-type IDs use safe fallback gear and log once per invalid ID. early_spartan_material is the Spartan registry material prefix, e.g. wooden, stone, copper, iron or diamond. Weapon archetypes are retained where possible; missing variants fall back to early vanilla melee, bows/crossbows or shields. Arbitrary gun strength cannot be inferred from material names, so only gun spawn chance changes. If quotes in this description appear backslash-escaped, remove those escape backslashes from actual ID settings and retain the enclosing double quotes.

roamer._description_full_quality_day_en: Personal online day reaching baseline quality, 1–1000000; no quality reductions afterward.

roamer._description_early_trident_keep_chance_e: Initial chance to retain an already-rolled trident, 0–1.

Any roamer_legacy_roll retained in an old config is ignored; use roamer.spawning.spawn_multiplier in the corresponding rank file to reduce roamers. Day gates, safe distance, light, density and encounter cooldown remain; flare/beacon summons are unchanged.
spawning._说明_中文: 自然遭遇生成总开关、准入概率、遭遇冷却、搜索半径和附近人类密度限制。admission_chance 与 battle_admission_chance 均支持 0–1 的小数：1=100%、0.1=10%、0.01=1%、0.001=0.1%、0=禁止对应遭遇。直接填写 JSON 数字，不加引号或百分号；这不是每 tick 的实际刷新概率。
spawning._description_en: Controls natural encounters: master toggle, admission probabilities, encounter cooldown, search radii and local human-density scaling. admission_chance and battle_admission_chance accept decimals from 0 to 1: 1=100%, 0.1=10%, 0.01=1%, 0.001=0.1%, and 0 disables the corresponding encounter. Enter JSON numbers without quotes or a percent sign; these are not actual per-tick spawn probabilities.
spawning._说明_概率与倍率_中文: 普通自然遭遇的概率环节为 min(1, admission_chance × 对应阶级文件 中本阶的 spawn_multiplier)。例如 0.08 × 0.1 = 0.008，即 0.8% 的基础准入机会，之后仍要通过密度、安全位置、冷却和解锁天数等条件；四阶均无额外隐藏概率。自然大型战斗另用 battle_admission_chance，不乘本阶 spawn_multiplier，且仍要通过其原有生成条件。只减某一阶的普通自然生成，改 对应阶级文件；降低所有普通自然遭遇，改 admission_chance；减少自然大型战斗，改 battle_admission_chance。信号弹/敌对信标召唤不受这些准入概率影响。
spawning._description_probability_and_multiplier_: Ordinary natural encounters use min(1, admission_chance × that tier's spawn_multiplier in the corresponding rank file) for their admission roll. For example, 0.08 × 0.1 = 0.008, or 0.8% base admission, followed by density, safe-position, cooldown, unlocked-day and other checks; none of the four ranks has an additional hidden probability gate. Automatic large battles instead use battle_admission_chance without the tier spawn_multiplier and must still pass their original conditions. Edit the corresponding rank file to reduce one tier's ordinary natural spawns, admission_chance to reduce all ordinary natural encounters, or battle_admission_chance to reduce automatic large battles. Flare/beacon summons are unaffected by these admission probabilities.

progression._说明_中文: 按玩家 UUID 独立保存累计在线时间，从第 1 天开始，24000 个在线游戏 tick 为一天（20 TPS 时约 20 分钟）。离线或单人暂停不累计，睡觉、/time、doDaylightCycle 不影响进度。生成点以同维度最近的存活非旁观玩家为依据，装备成长使用同一个计时来源；多人共用世界，已生成敌人仍可遇到其他玩家。每 200 tick 批量结算，正常退出结算余量，随世界正常保存，不在生成查询中读写文件。旧世界日历和偏移不迁移。/hostilehumans day get [玩家] 查看，set <天数> [玩家]、add <增减天数> [玩家] 由管理员调整；不带玩家时操作自己，控制台需指定玩家；已移除 sync。仅限制自然生成和自然大型战斗，不影响两类信号召唤、刷怪蛋、命令、结构固定单位或已有实体。关闭 enabled 取消解锁日期限制，不关闭独立的装备成长。
progression._description_en: Accumulates online game ticks independently by player UUID, starting on day 1. One day is 24000 ticks (about 20 minutes at 20 TPS). Offline time and single-player pauses do not count; sleep, /time and doDaylightCycle do not affect progress. Uses the nearest living non-spectator player in the spawn dimension for both unlocks and equipment growth. Spawned enemies are shared and may encounter other players. Settles every 200 ticks and at normal logout, saved with the world; spawn queries perform no file I/O. Old world-calendar offsets are not migrated. /hostilehumans day get [player] queries; administrator set <day> [player] and add <days> [player] adjust personal progress. Omit player to target yourself; console must specify one. sync is removed. Applies only to natural spawns and automatic battles, not flares, beacons, eggs, commands, fixed structure units or existing entities. Disabling enabled removes unlock gates, not independent equipment growth.
progression._说明_安全日_中文: safe_days 为开局完全禁止自然刷新人类的完整天数（0–1000000）。安全日和各阶解锁日同时生效，按较晚者开放；默认第 1 天安全，第 2 天仍无阶级解锁，第 3 天才开始流浪者自然生成。
progression._description_safe_days_en: safe_days is the number of complete opening days without natural human spawns (0–1000000). Both the safety period and tier unlock day must have elapsed. Defaults protect day 1; no tier is unlocked on day 2, and roamers begin on day 3.

first_spawn_day_by_tier._说明_中文: 各阶最早开始自然生成的模组日（1–1000000）。roamer=流浪者，tier1/tier2/tier3=一/二/三阶；独立配置，不要求按顺序递增。解锁只允许参与原有生成判定，不保证当天必定生成；自然大型战斗只能使用已解锁的一阶或二阶单位。
first_spawn_day_by_tier._description_en: First eligible mod day per tier (1–1000000). roamer, tier1, tier2 and tier3 are independently configurable; ascending order is not required. Unlocking permits existing spawn rules but does not guarantee a spawn. Automatic large battles use only unlocked tier I or tier II units.

ai._说明_中文: 战斗 AI、逃跑与恢复、举盾、战术走位、队友间距、跳跃、物品恢复和动作速度修正。时长和间隔单位为 tick（20 tick=1 秒）；概率为 0 到 1，动作倍率为 0.1 到 1。
ai._description_en: Combat AI, retreat and recovery, shield timing, tactical movement, ally spacing, jumping, item recovery and action speed modifiers. Durations and intervals are in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second); chances range from 0 to 1 and action multipliers from 0.1 to 1.
ai._说明_动作速度倍率_中文: food_use_speed_multiplier 和 shield_use_speed_multiplier 分别设置进食、普通举盾时的移速修正（允许 0.1–1）。默认进食 0.7，即附加 -30%；普通举盾配置默认 0.2，即附加 -80%。战斗 AI 的移动格挡（包括弹射物预判）至少保留 0.4 倍速度属性，避免举盾推进过慢；配置高于 0.4 时采用配置值。喝药不额外施加移速惩罚。
ai._description_action_speed_multipliers_en: food_use_speed_multiplier and shield_use_speed_multiplier set movement modifiers while eating or using a regular shield (range 0.1–1). Food defaults to 0.7 (-30%); regular shield use defaults to 0.2 (-80%). Combat AI mobile blocks, including projectile guards, retain at least 0.4x movement speed; higher configured values are respected. Drinking adds no extra movement penalty.
ai._说明_retreat_health_ratio_中文: 撤退生命比例，0.1–0.9；0.3表示剩余30%生命。
ai._description_retreat_health_ratio_en: Retreat health ratio, 0.1–0.9; 0.3 means 30% health remains.
ai._说明_critical_health_ratio_中文: 危急生命比例，0.05–0.75；实际不高于撤退阈值。
ai._description_critical_health_ratio_en: Critical health ratio, 0.05–0.75; capped at the retreat threshold.
ai._说明_resume_health_ratio_中文: 恢复作战生命比例，0.2–1；至少比撤退阈值高0.05。
ai._description_resume_health_ratio_en: Resume-combat health ratio, 0.2–1; at least 0.05 above retreat.
ai._说明_cover_search_attempts_中文: 掩体候选尝试数，2–24；过大增加寻路开销。
ai._description_cover_search_attempts_en: Cover candidate attempts, 2–24; larger values increase pathfinding work.
ai._说明_recovery_damage_tolerance_ratio_中文: 恢复过程中可容忍的受伤比例，0–1；按最大生命计算。
ai._description_recovery_damage_tolerance_r: Damage tolerance during recovery, 0–1 of maximum health.
ai._说明_recovery_commit_ticks_中文: 恢复动作承诺时间，0–40 tick；20 tick=1秒。
ai._description_recovery_commit_ticks_en: Recovery commitment time, 0–40 ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second.
ai._说明_gradual_heal_interval_ticks_中文: 食物及再生额外回血间隔，2–40 tick；食物每次最多1点生命，再生I额外1点、再生II额外2点，可叠加。
ai._description_gradual_heal_interval_ticks: Food and bonus regeneration interval, 2–40 ticks. Food heals up to 1 HP per pulse; Regeneration I adds 1 HP and II adds 2 HP independently.
ai._说明_food_recovery_min_health_中文: 食物恢复生命量下限，0–20点；不是生命比例。
ai._description_food_recovery_min_health_en: Minimum food recovery health, 0–20 points; not a health ratio.
ai._说明_food_recovery_max_health_中文: 食物恢复生命量上限，1–30点；不是食物品质评分。
ai._description_food_recovery_max_health_en: Maximum food recovery health, 1–30 points; not food pickup value.
ai._说明_food_use_speed_multiplier_中文: 进食时移动属性倍率，0.1–1；默认0.7即保留70%速度。
ai._description_food_use_speed_multiplier_e: Movement multiplier while eating, 0.1–1; 0.7 retains 70% speed.
ai._说明_shield_block_duration_min_ticks_中文: 普通举盾时长下限，3–30 tick。
ai._说明_shield_block_duration_max_ticks_中文: 普通举盾时长上限，4–160 tick；至少比下限高1。
ai._description_shield_block_duration_max_t: Maximum normal shield duration, 4–160 ticks; at least one above the minimum.
ai._说明_shield_block_chance_after_hit_中文: 受击后尝试普通举盾的概率，0–1。
ai._description_shield_block_chance_after_h: Chance to attempt normal shielding after a hit, 0–1.
ai._说明_shield_use_speed_multiplier_中文: 普通举盾移动倍率，0.1–1；预判弹射物格挡时至少保留0.7。
ai._description_shield_use_speed_multiplier: Normal shield movement multiplier, 0.1–1; predictive projectile blocks retain at least 0.7.
ai._说明_combat_jump_interval_min_中文: 战斗跳跃间隔下限，4–40 tick。
ai._说明_combat_jump_interval_max_中文: 战斗跳跃间隔上限，5–60 tick；至少比下限高1。
ai._description_combat_jump_interval_max_en: Maximum combat jump interval, 5–60 ticks; at least one above minimum.
ai._说明_combat_jump_chance_中文: 符合跳跃条件时的跳跃概率，0–1。
ai._说明_item_recovery_enabled_中文: 本阶物品恢复与初始补给开关；出生药水还受potions.enabled控制。
ai._description_item_recovery_enabled_en: Item recovery/initial supplies switch; spawn potions also require potions.enabled.
ai._说明_flee_hp_中文: 原生低血撤退生命比例，0–1；不是增强AI的retreat_health_ratio。
ai._description_flee_hp_en: Native low-health retreat ratio, 0–1; distinct from enhanced retreat_health_ratio.
ai._说明_run_away_middle_fight_chance_中文: 原生战斗中选择逃跑的概率，0–1。
ai._说明_mid_battle_buff_instead_of_run_chanc: 原生战斗中选择强化而非逃跑的概率，0–1。
ai._description_mid_battle_buff_instead_of_: Native mid-fight chance to buff instead of retreating, 0–1.
ai._说明_旧原生行为_中文: 以下选项也按阶独立：flee_hp旧低血量比例；run_away_middle_fight_chance逃跑选择概率；mid_battle_buff_instead_of_run_chance原二阶临战恢复概率；greet_chance敌对台词概率。均为0至1。
ai._description_native_ai_en: Per-rank legacy AI: flee_hp health ratio, run_away_middle_fight_chance retreat choice, mid_battle_buff_instead_of_run_chance existing tier-2 recovery choice, and greet_chance hostile dialogue. Each uses a 0-1 range.

recruitment._说明_中文: 全局雇佣关系与消息设置；人数上限和费用在各阶recruitment中设置。
recruitment._description_en: Global hiring relationships and message settings; limits and payments are in each rank recruitment section.

max_hired_by_tier._说明_中文: 每位玩家各阶正式雇佣人数上限。
max_hired_by_tier._description_en: Maximum permanent hires per player for each tier.

payment_by_tier._说明_中文: 各阶每次正式雇佣额外支付的物品与数量，合同仍另外消耗 1 张。item 填完整物品注册 ID（模组命名空间:物品名），不是翻译名、文件路径或 TaCZ 枪械的 GunId。例如 item 填 minecraft:diamond、count 填 16，表示支付 16 个钻石；其他模组也可用，例如 create:brass_ingot。按物品 ID 匹配，不限制 NBT；可跨背包多个格子合计。count 必须为 0 至 1000000 的整数，0 表示仅消耗合同。无效 ID、未安装物品所属模组、空气或非法数量会阻止生存雇佣，不扣款。创造模式不支付。修改后重启游戏；服务器以服务端配置为准。
payment_by_tier._description_en: Additional item payment per permanent hire; one contract is consumed separately. item is the full registered item ID (namespace:item), not a translated name, file path or TaCZ GunId. Example: item minecraft:diamond with count 16 costs 16 diamonds; modded items such as create:brass_ingot are supported. Matching uses item ID without NBT restrictions and totals multiple inventory slots. count must be an integer from 0 to 1000000; 0 consumes only the contract. Invalid/unregistered IDs, missing mods, air or invalid counts block survival hiring without payment. Creative hiring is free. Restart after edits; server settings are authoritative.

soldier_messages._说明_中文: 所有士兵共享其主人的消息预算，不按每个士兵分别计算。日常闲聊、战斗开始/结束、撤退等普通自动台词：默认至少相隔 1200 tick（60 秒），滚动 5 分钟最多 3 条；chatter_max_per_five_minutes 设为 0 可关闭普通自动台词。低血量、食物耗尽及装备破损使用独立状态报告预算：默认至少相隔 100 tick（5 秒），滚动 1 分钟最多 6 条。并发报告合并为一条消息，最多列出 3 条详情，余下显示合并数量；低血量优先。重复的同一士兵/同类待发报告合并，待发详情最多 32 条，不无限积压。报告可能延后或仅显示汇总；主动雇佣和玩家操作命令的反馈不受这些自动消息限额影响。tick 按 20 TPS 换算；修改后重启。
soldier_messages._description_en: All soldiers share their owner's message budget. Automatic chatter, combat transitions and retreat lines default to a 1200-tick (60-second) gap and at most 3 messages per rolling 5 minutes; chatter_max_per_five_minutes=0 disables ordinary automatic dialogue. Critical health, food exhaustion and equipment breaks use a separate report budget: a 100-tick (5-second) gap and at most 6 batches per rolling minute. Concurrent reports are merged, showing up to 3 details plus an additional-count summary, with critical health first. Repeated pending reports from the same soldier/category coalesce; detail storage is capped at 32. Reports may be delayed or summarized. Hiring and player-requested command acknowledgements are not limited by these automatic budgets. Tick conversions assume 20 TPS; restart after changes.

better_combat._说明_中文: 士兵的 Better Combat 可选兼容，默认开启。安装 Better Combat 时，士兵近战使用其武器攻击形状/范围、攻击速度冷却和扇形多目标判定；不影响玩家攻击，也不会叠加另一套攻击 Goal。未安装 Better Combat 时自动回退到本模组原有 AI、分阶随机攻击间隔、伤害与单体近战判定。可手动关闭此项；修改后需重启游戏。
better_combat._description_en: Optional Better Combat integration for soldiers; enabled by default. When Better Combat is installed, soldier melee uses its weapon hitbox shape/range, attack-speed cooldown, and multi-target arc checks. Player attacks are unaffected and no second attack Goal is added. If Better Combat is absent, soldiers automatically fall back to this mod's existing AI, tier-based random attack intervals, damage, and single-target melee checks. This option can be disabled manually; restart the game after changing it.

ammunition._说明_中文: 全局远程弹药总开关。true：所有人类弓弩射击与枪械换弹消耗本模组补给；false：无储备也可射击、装填和换弹，不扣除已有库存。枪内子弹、正常装填时长与闲置低于25%/战斗打空阈值仍保留，三叉戟不受影响。每阶初始补给数量在对应阶级文件的ammunition设置。
ammunition._description_en: Global ranged ammunition switch. true: Human bows/crossbows and firearm reloads consume mod supplies; false: zero reserves do not block firing, loading or reloads and inventory supplies are not deducted. Guns retain internal round capacity, reload timing and idle below 25%/empty-in-combat thresholds. Tridents are unaffected. Initial supplies belong to ammunition in each rank file.

native_gameplay._说明_中文: 旧TOML全局项：disabled_structures逗号分隔结构名；max_targeting同时攻击玩家的人类上限；no_waystones禁用结构路标；battle_event为HumanVsHuman/HumanVsPillager/Random/Disabled。
native_gameplay._description_en: Former TOML global settings: comma-separated disabled structures, concurrent targeting limit, structure waystone disable switch, and HumanVsHuman/HumanVsPillager/Random/Disabled battle events.

tacz._说明_野外枪械_中文: natural_spawn_firearms_enabled 控制自然生成和自然大型战斗中的人类是否额外携带枪械，默认 true。关闭不改变近战、弓弩、盾牌或护甲池，也不禁用 TaCZ 兼容、已有枪械、雇佣后的输入或信号召唤。开启时继续使用原有按阶枪械概率与自然装备成长倍率，枪械占武器数量名额且保留近战备用；本阶 allow_tacz_firearms 仍可进一步禁止该阶生成枪械。
tacz._description_natural_firearms_en: natural_spawn_firearms_enabled defaults true and controls extra firearms for natural spawns and automatic natural battles. Disabling it leaves other equipment pools unchanged, and does not disable TaCZ integration, existing guns, hired input or signal summons. Existing tier chances and growth multipliers apply when enabled. Guns count toward spawn weapon caps and retain a melee backup. Per-rank allow_tacz_firearms can additionally disable firearm generation for that rank.
tacz._说明_中文: 全局TaCZ兼容、自然枪械开关、枪械ID名单、通用伤害及其他枪手兼容。各阶概率、类型权重和输出倍率见本阶tacz。
tacz._description_en: Global TaCZ integration, natural-firearm switch, gun ID lists, shared damage and other-gunner compatibility. Rank chances, type weights and damage factors are in each rank tacz section.
tacz._说明_枪械生成_中文: 全局强制远程职业枪械概率、枪械掉落率和自动登记规则；本阶额外携枪概率在阶级文件tacz.gun_chance。
tacz._description_gun_generation_en: Global forced-ranged firearm chance, gun drop chance and automatic registration. Rank extra firearm chances are in rank tacz.gun_chance.
tacz._说明_枪械伤害_中文: 全局人类枪伤倍率human_gun_damage_multiplier乘本阶tacz.damage_multiplier；卫道士枪伤使用pillager_gun_damage_multiplier。
tacz._description_gun_damage_en: Global human_gun_damage_multiplier multiplies rank tacz.damage_multiplier; pillager firearms use pillager_gun_damage_multiplier.
tacz._说明_枪械分布_中文: 各阶随机枪械类型的相对权重；权重不是概率，某阶所有类型权重会共同决定抽取比例。
tacz._description_gun_type_weights_en: Relative weights for randomly selected firearm types per tier; these are not probabilities and jointly determine the distribution.
tacz._说明_枪械名单_中文: 两个白名单均为 JSON 对象，键是枪械注册ID（命名空间:路径，不是背包物品ID）。本说明字段内附有可复制的 JSON 格式示例；示例中的枪械ID需替换为枪包实际注册ID。JSON 键需用双引号括起，键和值之间用冒号，不同条目用英文逗号分隔，最后一项后不要加逗号。gun_whitelist 用于野生枪手：正整数是同类枪械内的相对抽取权重，权重总和无需等于100，系统会按比例抽取；0 明确排除该枪。auto_add_new_guns 紧邻此项：开启时，未列出的可用枪械会按 auto_added_gun_weight 加入野生抽选池；若严格只要名单中的枪械，请关闭它。hired_gun_additional_whitelist 仅允许额外枪械被放入已雇佣人类背包，任意正整数即允许，数值大小不影响允许结果。基础 gun_whitelist 为空时，雇佣单位可接受所有可识别枪械；非空时接受基础名单或追加名单里的正权重枪械。gun_blacklist 是独立字符串数组，列出的枪械ID会被排除。格式示例：{"gun_whitelist":{"tacz:example_rifle_a":5,"some_gunpack:example_rifle_b":2},"auto_add_new_guns":false,"hired_gun_additional_whitelist":{"some_gunpack:example_sniper":1}}。从本说明复制示例到实际配置时，请删除每个双引号前的反斜杠转义符，只保留普通双引号；反斜杠仅用于本说明字符串的外层 JSON 转义。
tacz._description_gun_lists_en: Both whitelists are JSON objects keyed by registered gun IDs (namespace:path, not the inventory item ID). A copyable JSON syntax example is included in this description; replace its sample gun IDs with IDs actually registered by your gun packs. JSON keys must be double-quoted, a colon separates each key from its value, entries are separated by English commas, and there must be no trailing comma. gun_whitelist is used for wild gunner selection: positive integers are relative weights among guns of the same category. Their sum does not need to equal 100; selection is proportional to the weights. A value of 0 explicitly excludes that gun. auto_add_new_guns is placed beside this list: when enabled, unlisted eligible guns enter the wild selection pool with auto_added_gun_weight. Disable it to restrict wild spawns to listed guns. hired_gun_additional_whitelist only allows extra guns to be inserted into hired humans' inventories; any positive integer allows the gun, and its size does not affect permission. If the base gun_whitelist is empty, hired units can accept any recognized gun; otherwise they accept positive entries from either list. gun_blacklist is a separate string array of excluded gun IDs. Example: {"gun_whitelist":{"tacz:example_rifle_a":5,"some_gunpack:example_rifle_b":2},"auto_add_new_guns":false,"hired_gun_additional_whitelist":{"some_gunpack:example_sniper":1}}. When copying the example from this description into the actual config, remove the backslash escape before each quote and keep ordinary double quotes; those escapes are required only because the example is embedded in this JSON description string.
tacz._说明_枪械承伤与盾牌_中文: 这里是目标承伤修正，不是攻击者输出的覆盖项。shield_damage_multiplier 在人类正在使用盾牌且受到 TaCZ 子弹伤害时额外相乘（0.3 保留 30% 的输入伤害），当前判定不验证子弹方向或真实格挡命中；该人类所属阶级的 incoming_damage_multiplier 仍会参与。tamed_maid_damage_multiplier 额外修正已驯服女仆承受的 TaCZ 枪伤，不区分攻击者；人类射击女仆时还会同时应用人类枪械全局和阶级倍率。目标护甲等减伤仍按原流程计算，不保证最终扣血比例。人类对女仆的近战倍率另见 global.json 的 damage.tamed_maid_melee_damage_multiplier。
tacz._description_gun_damage_taken_en: These are defender-side factors, not overrides for outgoing damage. shield_damage_multiplier additionally applies when a Human is actively using a shield and receives TaCZ bullet damage (0.3 retains 30% of input damage); the current check does not validate bullet direction or an actual blocked hit. That Human tier's incoming_damage_multiplier still applies. tamed_maid_damage_multiplier additionally scales TaCZ damage received by a tamed maid regardless of attacker; a Human shooting a maid also uses the Human firearm global and tier values. Native armor and other mitigation still apply, so these are not guaranteed final health-loss ratios. Human melee damage to maids uses damage.tamed_maid_melee_damage_multiplier in global.json.
tacz._说明_兼容字段_中文: 仅供非 Hostile Humans 实体使用的枪手散布回退值；Hostile Humans 人类枪手使用 tiers 中逐阶、逐枪械类型的 weapon_spread_degrees。
tacz._description_compat_fields_en: Fallback gunner spread for non-Hostile-Humans entities only. Hostile Humans gunners use per-tier, per-firearm weapon_spread_degrees under tiers.
